name: Malaysian Food Truck Association (MAFTA)
website_note: No website found. Seen only in press (Bernama/The Star/The Sun 2019, The Star 2022). The 2022 blog repost yudasitar.blogspot.com has no page link.
members_estimate: 820 registered food truck operators (Sinar Harian/Bernama, undated, c. 2019)
notes: Real association (chairman Datuk Mohamad Zaini Md Taha), but I found nothing after July 2022 and no Facebook page, email or contact route. Source for members: https://www.sinarharian.com.my/ampArticle/30606.

name: Kuala Lumpur Food Truck Entrepreneur Association (KLFTEA)
website_note: No website found. Seen only in The Vibes (May and July 2024) and The Star (Dec 2021).
members_estimate: 250 licensed registered members (The Vibes, May 2024); 'over 700 members manning 2,000 food trucks' (The Vibes, 3 Jul 2024)
notes: President Muhammad Azlan Abas was quoted in July 2024 on DBKL parking. Searches found no Facebook or Instagram page, so no channel is set; a reporter contact or a manual Facebook search is the next step.

name: SME Mobile Truck Association (SMEMTA)
website_note: No website found. The only mention is the Jan 2020 Star Media Group rally announcement (SME Mobile Truck Revolution 2020, Bukit Jalil, 21-22 Mar 2020).
notes: It exists only in coverage of one 2020 rally, which was probably disrupted by the March 2020 MCO lockdown. I found no later activity, social page or Malay-name presence.

name: Sarawak Bumiputera FoodTruck Association (SBFA)
website_note: No website found. Seen in Borneo Post and Sarawak Tribune coverage from 2016 to 2019.
members_estimate: Chairman cited 25 food trucks and 20 food carts in Sarawak (Sarawak Tribune, 3 Apr 2019)
notes: Chairman Mahathir Ibrahim. The 2019 article prints a personal mobile number (012-8965815), but I found no official page or Facebook. Sarawak Tribune pages show a 2026 date banner, but the articles are from 2016 to 2019.

name: The Food Truck Association (India)
website_note: tfta.in was linked from the 2016 Indian Restaurant Congress partner page; the domain no longer resolves (no A or MX record).
members_estimate: 83 food trucks counted nationally in its Jan 2016 survey (openthemagazine.com)
notes: It was a partner of the Indian Restaurant Congress in Aug 2016. The congress page's contact email is Cloudflare-obfuscated and probably belongs to the organisers. I found nothing after 2016 and no social page.

name: Indonesian Food Truck Association / Jakarta Food Truck
website_note: No website found. 'Indonesian Food Truck Association' appears only as a cited source in a Jakpat survey and a 2016 blog. 'Jakarta Food Truck' was a single truck business started in late 2013 (Jakarta Post, Apr 2014), not an association.
members_estimate: 40 trucks in Jakarta (Jakpat survey citing the association, undated); 70 trucks (2016 blog)
notes: Searches found no trace of the @jktfoodtruck handle, so it is unverified. Possible substitute: Komunitas Food Truck Jakarta (since 2016, Instagram @komunitas_foodtruck_jakarta per an alinear.id article snippet), which is a different group and not checked.

name: Food Truck Association of the Philippines
website_note: No website found. Seen only in 2012-2013 blogs and press around the Cucina Andare food truck market (also called Philippine or Metro Manila Food Truck Association).
notes: It launched in Dec 2012 at the Cucina Andare market and has been dormant since about 2013. I found no Facebook page or any later evidence.

name: Truckers DXB
website_note: truckers.ae now hosts an unrelated SEO/backlink blog (newest post Aug 2026), so the domain has lapsed or been taken over. The group rebranded to Truckers UAE by 2019.
members_estimate: ~60 trucks across Dubai and Abu Dhabi for Season 3 (late 2017, eyeofriyadh.com); 15 trucks at the 2017 Summer Warehouse
notes: The newest evidence is a Truckers UAE fair at Emirates Golf Club on 26 Oct 2019 (article dated 14 Oct 2019). The Instagram handle comes from a 2017 post link; whether the account is still current is unverified.

name: TLUNCH (mellow)
website_note: tlunch.com now redirects to a HugeDomains for-sale page. Operator Mellow Inc. (Minato-ku, Tokyo) runs the platform as SHOP STOP at mellow.jp, and the TLUNCH name no longer appears there.
members_estimate: 4,550 partner shops, ~1,440 locations, ~3,600 trucks available for events (mellow.jp, Nov 2026); 400 trucks / 85 Tokyo sites in 2018 (newswitch.jp/p/14593)
notes: This is a software platform, not an association: it matches food trucks with vacant spaces (formerly TLUNCH, now SHOP STOP app). It is a likely competitor or partner, so do not auto-send.
